related_issues.reason: Build-system.requires resolution involving prerelease-only dependencies; related context on how build requirements handle prereleases, but a different problem.

rationale: The reporter acknowledges that 0.12 changed the default to if-necessary and that --prerelease and related settings have never applied to build requirements. This is a request to extend those options to build requirements, or to add a new one such as --build-prerelease, so it is an enhancement rather than a bug. The silent-ignore point is a fair complaint but is not a documented contract violation. The report has versions, a clear description and workarounds, so no MRE is needed. Searches found no duplicate of this request; only issue 16494 surfaced as loosely related. Docs search returned no page documenting prerelease handling for build requirements, which I did not read in full.
